visualCharacteristics.purpose: section title bar: a large heading on the left with a 'View all' style link or button on the right, underlined by a rule; or a coloured text panel beside a photo

contentPattern.structure: one row: a heading cell (heading and optional text) and an optional link cell; a single cell whose trailing paragraphs are only links also works. promo-panel: a text cell (heading, text, optional CTA) and a picture-only cell; cell order sets the image side. A cell holding only a link to a /fragments/ page is replaced by that fragment. Panel colour comes from the section style, not from the block

usage: Use above a card grid or listing to title the section with a 'View all' link. promo-panel shows a short announcement in a coloured panel next to a photo.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any heading-plus-link section title. Use plain default content for a heading with no link, and cta-banner for a full call-to-action strip.
